mathematical_premises.scope: orientation-free rank-two quadratic half-Riesz potential with arbitrary original-coordinate affine term
completed designated-partner collar theorems; first applied to 2X1X2+Z^2+2kappa ZW and second supplies continuity/<13 for the six-coordinate collar family
top two crossing singular values stay uniformly paid; naive L1_W(L2_v) same-bank bridge is false

new_results.statement: For Y=gamma X+H(Z,W) and any invertible symmetric 3x3 core M=[[a,c^T],[c,B]] with a!=0 acting on (Y,u.Z,v.Z), the output density is at most 128(L_X/|gamma|)[|a det M| detGram(u,v)]^(-1/4), with 16sqrt(30) in the in-plane affine case.
For Q=H_X+2u^T S v+2kappa zW+h.Y+c with (v,W) a right-bank orthogonal 3D product projection and left planar density cap M2, ||p_Q||_infinity <=2 sqrt(pi M2/|det S|), uniformly in kappa.
new_results.mechanism: condition on the entire left bank; the right side is one original-coordinate linear form; average its reciprocal coefficient as an integrable 1/|u| kernel in two dimensions

partner_result_actually_applied.application: Partner proves the target-valid family Q_kappa=2ZX1+2X1Y1+2X2Y2+2kappa ZW has continuous density <13. The new theorem applies with M2=1,S=I and sharpens the essential height to 2sqrt(pi)=3.544907701811..., uniformly in kappa. Partner also gives 8*2^(1/4) for 2X1X2+Z^2+2kappa ZW.

later_partner_checkpoint.summary: Product-provenance Fourier-slice replacement gives a nonuniform |kappa|^(-1/3) punctured bound; uniform interpolation through kappa=0 remains open.

unresolved_implication: QFORM-SCHUR-COMPATIBLE-SAMEBANK-COLLAR-v1: in the punctured exact-rank-three split with D=B^T C^{-1}B and sigma1(B)sigma2(B) uniformly paid, prove a density bound uniform as sigma3(B)->0 while retaining product provenance, or reduce by an original-coordinate cut to a paid branch.
rank_two_control: For centered unit uniforms, p_(2XY)(t)=log(1/(2|t|)) on 0<|t|<1/2; this remains the mandatory opposite-sign logarithmic endpoint.
continuity: Not proved by the two new theorems. The designated partner's six-coordinate family has continuity from its independent Fourier proof.
